graph.title: BEKANT table frame

steps.title: Start the half-round frame
steps.instruction: For the half-round table, lay the frame pieces upside down on a soft surface. Slide the curved rail and straight rail into the two leg units, matching the tabs and holes shown in the close-ups.
warnings: Do not work directly on a hard floor.

steps.title: Fasten one side and add the next leg unit
steps.instruction: Tighten four bolts with the Allen key to secure the first frame section. Then slide the next leg unit onto the straight rail, keeping all legs pointing upward because the frame is still upside down.

steps.title: Complete and bolt the half-round frame
steps.instruction: Fit the remaining straight rail into the open sockets, checking that the tabs line up with the matching holes. Tighten five more bolts with the Allen key so the upside-down frame is square and secure.

steps.title: Attach the half-round tabletop
steps.instruction: Place the half-round tabletop face down on the soft surface, then set the frame on it and align the holes. Screw in five threaded inserts, then tap five pegs into them with a hammer.
warnings: Keep the tabletop on a soft surface to avoid scratches.

steps.title: Level the half-round table
steps.instruction: Turn the half-round table upright with help. Use the adjustable feet to raise or lower each leg, and check the tabletop with a spirit level until it stands steady.
warnings: Have a second person help turn the table upright.

steps.title: Start the rectangular frame
steps.instruction: For the rectangular table, fasten the center support between the two long side rails with four long bolts. Then slide a leg unit onto each rail end, matching the tabs with the holes.

steps.title: Complete and bolt the rectangular frame
steps.instruction: Add the remaining rails to close the rectangular frame, making sure every corner socket is fully seated. Tighten eight bolts with the Allen key at the corner brackets.

steps.title: Prepare and attach the rectangular tabletop
steps.instruction: Lay the two tabletop panels face down and push them together so the center opening lines up. Place the frame on top, align the holes, and screw in eight threaded inserts.
warnings: Keep the tabletop panels on a soft surface, not a bare floor.

steps.title: Lock the tabletop and level the table
steps.instruction: Tap eight pegs into the threaded inserts to lock the frame to the tabletop. With help, turn the table upright and adjust all four feet until the tabletop is level.
warnings: Have a second person help turn the table upright.

steps.title: Fit the cable outlet and join tables if needed
steps.instruction: Press the cable outlet into the opening in the rectangular tabletop. If you are connecting the half-round table to it, place the two joining brackets under the meeting edge as shown and secure the tables together.

notes: Assemble the BEKANT table frame for the half-round add-on table or the rectangular table, attach the tabletop, level the legs, and fit the cable-management parts. The final page also shows how to connect the half-round table to another BEKANT table using the joining brackets.
Use two people for handling and assembly; do not assemble alone.
Protect the parts by working on a soft surface such as a rug or blanket, not directly on a hard floor.
If anything is unclear or missing, contact IKEA before continuing.
